Check that a model rests on enough observations

check_model.Rd

A model fitted to very few observations can reveal individual values: with zero residual degrees of freedom the fitted values are the data. And a fitted model object carries its data: lm and glm objects hold the model frame, residuals and fitted values for every person, and so does summary.lm(). Release a table of coefficients instead. The check fails when

  • the object contains row-level components (model, residuals, fitted.values, y, qr, ...),

  • residual degrees of freedom are below config$min_df,

  • a factor level in the model data has fewer than min_count observations,

  • for a binary outcome, an outcome class has fewer than min_count observations.

Usage

check_model(fit, config = NULL, target = NULL)

Arguments

fit

A fitted model, for example from stats::lm() or stats::glm().

config

A mimic_config(); NULL uses the defaults.

target

Label used in reports.

Value

A mimic_check.

Details

It warns when a binary outcome has a cell with fewer than min_count observations within a factor level. Objects without stats::nobs(), stats::df.residual() or stats::model.frame() methods give a warning so they are reviewed by hand.

See also

Other checks: check_differencing(), check_dominance(), check_extremes(), check_group_disclosure(), check_k_anonymity(), check_keys(), check_min_count(), check_suppression()

Examples

# a fitted lm object holds the data: not for release
fit <- lm(income ~ sex + occupation, data = fake_persons)
check_model(fit)
#> ✖ model (fit): 1 issue(s) with the observations behind the model.
#>                                                                                                                                  issue
#>  the object contains row-level data (model, residuals, fitted.values, effects, qr, na.action); release a table of coefficients instead
#>  severity
#>      fail

# the observations behind it are fine once the row-level parts are removed
fit[c("model", "residuals", "fitted.values", "effects", "qr", "na.action")] <- NULL
check_model(fit)
#> ✔ model (fit): Model rests on enough observations (residual df at least 10).
